decisions.reason: As a certified and closely related extension of the core heat-exchanger portfolio, it still offers option value at modest incremental cost despite the lack of recent visible market proof.
Its earlier signs of strong market acceptance and fit with the firm's marine cooling capabilities make it a low-likelihood withdrawal case worth retaining.
After several years with little visible validation, this more specific marine product appears to have delivered too little evidence of scalable value to justify keeping the option open.
The compact oil cooler remains close enough to the established engineering and service base that keeping it is still cheaper than abandoning a potentially useful adjacent line.

This component-style offering seems less central to the firm's integrated solutions focus, and the absence of later signals suggests resources are better reallocated to stronger products and new development.
